title: Code, data and certificates for: Persistence of Non-Planarity under Minimal Binary Graph Rewriting
description: Rule enumeration, computer-assisted certificates (with a standalone checker), search outputs and experiment data supporting the paper "Persistence of Non-Planarity under Minimal Binary Graph Rewriting: Cycle Rank, Minor Preservation, and an Exhaustive Classification". Code is MIT-licensed; data, results and text are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA). To re-check the central claim: python3 scripts/verify_certificates.py
